decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling a board presence through using artifacts and creature tokens while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Metallic Rebuke. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Engineered Explosives. The use of cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga allows for recurring value and card advantage, helping to maintain pressure on the opponent throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Welding Jar provide additional utility and protection for key pieces of the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to use Eldrazi ramp cards to quickly generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while maintaining control of the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Formidable Speaker to provide additional utility and support for the Eldrazi strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing mana ramping Eldrazi creatures and control spells to overwhelm the opponent and stall the game until the big Eldrazi threats can be cast. The goal is to control the board with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Green Sun's Zenith, while using Disciple of Freyalise to generate mana quickly. Once enough mana is available, powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger can be brought out to dominate the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and control the game until victory is achieved.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes abilities like Prowess from cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler to further boost its aggressive strategy. The mana base is streamlined with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Bloodstained Mire, allowing for consistent casting of spells. The deck aims to finish off the opponent quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck revolves around assembling the Broodscale Bloodchief combo, utilizing cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Blade of the Bloodchief to create powerful synergies. It also includes cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command for added control and disruption. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to cast its powerful creatures and spells, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creature power and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures combined with blink effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control. By constantly flickering creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones with cards like Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to apply pressure while dodging removal spells. Cards like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter provide additional value through their abilities. The deck also includes interaction and disruption in the form of Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats and clear the way for your creatures to attack.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and using cards like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. With cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, alongside ways to protect your combo pieces like Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to control the game while setting up its powerful reanimation plays. By combining instant reanimation with powerful combo potential, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and efficient win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient artifacts. By using cards like Salvage Titan and Kappa Cannoneer alongside Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, the deck can quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. With cards like Engineered Explosives and Metallic Rebuke for removal and disruption, the deck aims to control the game while still maintaining a fast pace. Cards like Urza's Saga and Pinnacle Emissary provide additional value and versatility to keep the opponent on their toes.

The deck focuses on assembling a versatile toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and brought onto the battlefield using cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith. It includes creatures with various abilities such as removal (Yawgmoth, Thran Physician), recursion (Endurance), and resilience (Young Wolf). The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by constantly adapting to the board state and utilizing its creatures effectively to control the game and create advantageous situations for victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizing leyline enablers to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies. Ragavan and Territorial Kavu provide early threats, while Leyline of the Guildpact and Stubborn Denial protect your creatures. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding help maintain board presence, while Kroxa and Scion of Draco provide late-game power. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mixture of creatures and disruptive spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Lightning Bolt, Monastery Swiftspear, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure early on. The deck also includes cards like Boomerang Basics and Cori-Steel Cutter to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining burn spells with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Efficient card selection and tempo plays are crucial for success with this deck.

This deck focuses on creating an overwhelming board presence through the combo of Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief, supported by Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Devourer of Destiny. Utilizing cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble for control and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creature buffs and powerful threats. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures adds consistency and resilience to the strategy, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Quantum Riddler provide value and card advantage. The deck is built around a fast combo strategy, aiming to win the game before the opponent can react. Sideboard cards like Prismatic Ending and Spell Snare help deal with specific threats, while Faithful Mending and Superior Spider-Man provide card filtering and utility.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and control, utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent. With a combination of permission spells like Spell Snare, Force of Negation, and Counterspell, alongside removal like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, the deck aims to control the board while deploying threats like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares for a win condition. The deck also includes card draw and filtering with cards like Thoughtseize and Subtlety, ensuring card advantage and consistency in its strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and creature synergy to overwhelm opponents quickly. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls provide powerful threats, while Goblin Bombardment and Voice of Victory offer removal and combat tricks. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can create a strong board presence, while cards like Blood Moon and Fear of Missing Out disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes versatile spells like Prismatic Ending and Thraben Charm to deal with various threats. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to be proactive and apply pressure from the start.

The focus of this Boros Ponza deck is to control the opponent's resources through land destruction and removal spells, while also generating value from the graveyard. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by destroying their lands with cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin, while also protecting itself with removal spells like Path to Exile and Solitude. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Price of Freedom and Demolition Field to keep the pressure on the opponent and secure a win.
